posts.zh:
dsh-project-manager 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。在 DSH Web 界面以悬浮窗口管理开发项目：添加/删除、一键启动/停止/重启、文件变更热重载自动重启、实时日志查看与持久化。

posts.en:
dsh-project-manager is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Manage development projects from the DSH web UI in a draggable floating window: add/remove, one-click start/stop/restart, hot-reload restart on file changes, and real-time persistent logs.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ff892b863fc2efdd8e28.html
